scope: Bounded discovery of official Slovenian legal publication, EU/EEA/Swiss residence and family routes, visa and mission guidance, administrative procedure and remedies, family-status evidence, privacy, oversight, legal aid and selected case-law discovery. Not a complete national inventory or legal-equivalence opinion.
retrieval_status: 42 candidate responses captured; 23 candidate texts converted and replay-verified; 19 interactive or discovery shells. Seven GOV.SI references are accepted for dated external use; PISRS consolidated records are offered for whole-site human review because this review client receives a JavaScript shell. The API was not used; zero local copies and zero topics are accepted.

comparison_seed.source: Danish EU free-movement residence regulation and official guidance
comparison_seed.relationship_note: Slovenian ZTuj-2 and GOV.SI service pages are only functional comparison leads. GOV.SI expressly extends relevant EU-citizen Foreigners Act provisions to EEA citizens and their family members, while it gives Swiss citizens a separate EU-Swiss Agreement route. No legal equivalence is asserted.

previous_findings_carried_forward: Prior country reviews and taxonomy gaps are leads, not evidence of Slovenian coverage or legal equivalence.
Search legislation, operational guidance, forms, missions, procedure, file access, remedies, family-status evidence, privacy, oversight, legal aid and courts separately.
API documentation, public access, API authorization and legal-text reuse permission are separate evidence questions.
Czechia's stable date-bound PDF route is a possible retrieval pattern only; verify publisher terms and the route contract independently for Slovenia.
Keep EU, EEA EFTA and Swiss legal bases distinct; the Swiss route is expressly agreement-based.
